tagline: Your busy time, everywhere it needs to be.

setup.heading: Your calendars, under your control.
setup.intro: Create the administrator who can connect accounts, preview rules, and respond when synchronization needs attention.

privacy.localHistory: Event history is local, not in a vendor cloud

setup.emailNote: You sign in with this email and password.

login.heading: Welcome back.
login.intro: Sign in to check synchronization health and manage this installation.
login.passwordAlternative: Or use your email and password
login.passwordNote: Use the email and password you sign in with.
login.passwordOnlyHint: Upgraded from a version without email? Leave this empty to sign in with your password alone. You add your email next.

addEmail.heading: Add your email
addEmail.intro: From now on, you sign in with your email and password. If this installation sends email, it can also tell you when a rule needs attention.
addEmail.note: Only you and this installation's administrators see it.

invitation.heading: Join Calendar Ghost
invitation.intro: You were invited to this Calendar Ghost. Your calendars, rules, and Activity stay private to you.
invitation.note: Only you and this installation's administrators see your email.

unusable.title: This invitation cannot be used
unusable.body: It was already used or revoked, or it expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new link.

invitation.verifiedNote: Verify your email before choosing a password. Your invitation stays available until you finish joining or it expires.

passwordReset.heading: Choose a new password
passwordReset.intro: Use this link once to choose a new password. You will sign in afterward.
passwordReset.note: You sign in with your email and this password from now on.

unusable.title: This link cannot be used
unusable.body: It was already used or replaced, or it expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
unusable.recoveryBody: It was already used or replaced, or it expired. Request a new link to try again.

done.title: Your password was changed
done.body: Sign in with your email and your new password.

legal: © 2026 Calendar Ghost contributors · No warranty. Share and modify under the <license>AGPLv3+ license</license>; view the <source>source</source>.

forgotPassword.heading: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.intro: Request a link to choose a new password for this Calendar Ghost.
forgotPassword.note: Use the email you sign in with.
forgotPassword.sent: If this address can receive a reset link, we will send one.
forgotPassword.retry: Try again or use another email

unavailable.title: Email recovery is unavailable
unavailable.body: Email recovery is unavailable. Ask your administrator for a password reset link.

emailChange.heading: Confirm your email change
emailChange.intro: Your current email stays active until you confirm this change.
emailChange.note: Only the account that requested this link can use it.
emailChange.doneBody: Use your new email next time you sign in. Your other devices were signed out.
emailChange.unusable: This link cannot be used with this account. It may have expired or been replaced. Open Your account to request a new link, or sign in with the account that requested it.
emailChange.signIn: Sign in with your current email to continue.
emailChange.reopen: Keep this page open while signing in. If the link is lost after a refresh, reopen it from your email.
emailChange.doneIntro: Your account now uses your verified email.

signUp.heading: Create account
signUp.intro: Join this Calendar Ghost with a verified email. Your calendars, rules, and Activity stay private to you.
signUp.note: We will send a link to choose your password. The link works once and expires after 24 hours.
signUp.sent: If this address can join, we will send a verification link. Check your email, including spam. Requests are limited, so wait before trying again.
signUp.unavailable: Joining is unavailable right now. Try again later or ask the administrator. Existing accounts can still sign in.

registration.heading: Finish creating your account
registration.intro: Your email is verified when you finish this step. Choose the password you will sign in with.
registration.note: Only you and this installation's administrators see your email.
registration.unusableTitle: This verification link cannot be used
registration.unusable: It was already used, cancelled, or expired. Request a new link if joining is available.
registration.sessionBody: We could not sign you in. Use your verified email and the password you just chose to sign in.

provider.calendarStep: After signing in, connect your calendars in Connections.
provider.unavailable: Provider sign-in could not finish. Try again or use your email and password.
provider.invitationBinding: Use the same email with your provider. Joining requires the provider to verify that address and the Invitation to still be valid.
provider.linkIntro: Confirm your Calendar Ghost sign-in to link this provider.
provider.linkNote: Your password links the provider account you just used to the Calendar Ghost account you enter below.
provider.expired: This sign-in attempt is no longer available. Start again from Sign in.
provider.newcomer: New here? Create an account through email verification, then link your provider in Settings, Your account. If you were invited, reopen your Invitation to join.
provider.confirmFailed: Linking could not finish. Check your email and password, or start sign-in again.
provider.emailChange: Signing in with a provider opens your account. Reopen this email verification link afterward.
provider.invitationPasswordUnavailable: Password joining is unavailable for this link. A provider can still check whether your verified email and Invitation allow you to join.
